page.excerpt: After the November 2026 U.S. midterm elections, Bitcoin briefly climbed above $81,000, but the rally quickly faded. While it initially held up well after Democrats sweep of Congress, but the tech stock sell-off quickly wiped out its gains. BTC has since dropped to $73,700, leaving traders focused on what the election outcome really means for Bitcoin and crypto.
